research.primaryRule: Model-selected underdog with at least 2 of 3 advantages: rest/schedule, non-explosive down-to-down efficiency, QB passing efficiency/YPA
research.historicalStatus: exploratory discovery sample; not independently validated with actual historical sportsbook moneylines
secondaryRules: Model ML Watchlist may include dogs with meaningful spread-model value that do not clear the full 2-of-3 profile
+7.5 to +14 dogs are excluded from the primary Special algorithm because the historical signal was unstable across 2024 and 2025
Transfer-QB and other matchup traits may be displayed as context but do not alter Profile v1.0 qualification
research.parlayNote: Historical synthetic underdog-moneyline parlays were weak. Only independently qualifying, live-priced individual Specials may be combined, and any parlay remains experimental/high variance rather than a Best Bet.
research.versioningRule: Do not alter v1.0 qualification based on 2026 outcomes. Any rule change becomes a separately tracked version.

pricing.executionRule: A live moneyline must be verified before a candidate becomes actionable. Estimated/synthetic prices may inform fair value but cannot be stored as an executable market price.
pricing.lineShopping: Show a consistent primary/consensus price and optional best-available price; do not hindsight-select a bookmaker.

rest.reason: Both teams are opening the season; Hawaii also travels to the mainland, so there is no rest/schedule advantage.

nonExplosive.reason: Hawaii held the stronger down-to-down/early-down profile in the 2025 head-to-head and enters against a Stanford defense that finished 2025 near the bottom nationally in pass defense; the advantage is efficiency-based rather than dependent on isolated explosives.

qbYpa.reason: Micah Alejado returns after a highly efficient 2025 (66.3% completions, 3,106 yards, 24 TD) and ranked 16th in EPA/dropback in cited 2025 data, while Davis Warren's last healthy season produced materially weaker per-dropback efficiency.

candidates.note: Profile v1.0 clears 2 of 3 and the live ML is favorable to the frozen fair-ML estimate, but the underlying spread-model signal no longer qualifies after Hawaii moved from +4.5 to +3.5. The 2026 framework requires the model gate first, so neither ML action nor execution pricing is permitted.

rest.reason: Both teams are opening the season and Memphis travels to Las Vegas; no rest/schedule edge is established.

nonExplosive.reason: Current matchup analysis identifies Memphis' front seven as the unit most capable of winning down-to-down against UNLV's run-first offense and limiting its most repeatable offensive path.

qbYpa.reason: Marcus Stokes' strong Division II production is not a sufficiently comparable FBS YPA/efficiency sample to award the frozen QB advantage over experienced Jackson Arnold.

candidates.note: Memphis does not clear the 2-of-3 profile and the spread-model edge is only about 1 point. The verified +155 ML is also only marginally above the frozen fair estimate, so there is no actionable ML value.
